national_news.title: Ladakh Begins Digital Self-Enumeration for Census 2027
bullets: Ladakh has become the first Union Territory in India to commence the Census 2027 exercise, starting with self-enumeration from August 17 to 31.
The population enumeration phase is scheduled from September 1 to 30 with October 1 as the reference date, planned early to avoid harsh winter conditions.
Around 637 Enumeration Blocks have been created for complete digital coverage across the region, following the successful completion of the House Listing Operations phase.

national_news.title: NTA Announces Re-Test for Three UGC-NET June Exam Papers
bullets: The National Testing Agency (NTA) announced a re-test for English, Commerce, and Sociology papers of the UGC-NET June examination following committee recommendations on errors.
The English and Sociology re-tests are scheduled for September 9 and September 10 respectively in Shift 1, while Commerce will be held on September 9 in Shift 2.
The UGC-NET examination is conducted for the award of Junior Research Fellowship, eligibility for Assistant Professor, and PhD admissions across 87 subjects.

national_news.title: Annual Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra Begins in Jammu and Kashmir
bullets: The 12-day-long annual Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra commenced in the Poonch district of Jammu and Kashmir, culminating on Raksha Bandhan.
The ancient Baba Budha Amarnath Temple is located 4,600 feet above sea level in Rajpura village of Mandi Tehsil and features a self-manifested white stone Shivling.
Pilgrims traditionally bathe in the holy Pulastya River, named after Rishi Pulastya, before offering prayers at the shrine.

national_news.title: India to host 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: India is hosting the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi under India's BRICS Chairship 2026.
The overarching theme for the event is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Bhupender Yadav, will preside over the meeting.
India has identified four priority areas: Promoting Sustainable Lifestyles, Afforestation, Forest Fire Management and Disaster Resilience, Circular Economy, and Adaptation.

national_news.title: Dr Jitendra Singh Confers National Anubhav Awards 2026
bullets: Minister of State Dr Jitendra Singh conferred the National Anubhav Awards 2026 in New Delhi.
The event featured the release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra and Guidelines for the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-Five.
15 selected awardees were honored for their contributions to nation-building, administrative reforms, and technological adaptations.
The 'Anubhav' platform enables retiring and retired central government employees, public sector bank staff, and PSU employees to share their working experiences.

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships Begins in New Delhi
bullets: The BWF Badminton World Championships commenced at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi.
Key Indian participants include PV Sindhu (Women's singles), Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty (Men's doubles), and debutant Ayush Shetty.
Top Indian doubles and mixed pairs like Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto have received initial byes into advanced rounds.

national_news.title: India Play 2-2 Draw Against China in FIH Women's Hockey World Cup Opener
bullets: India started their FIH Women's Hockey World Cup campaign with a 2-2 draw against China in Amstelveen, Netherlands.
Navneet and Deepika scored for India in the eighth and 25th minutes respectively.
India and China are placed in Pool D along with England and South Africa.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen Wins Esports World Cup Chess Title for Second Consecutive Year
bullets: World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup chess title in Paris, France.
He defeated Belarusian Grandmaster Denis Lazavik 2-0 in the final, remaining undefeated throughout the tournament.
Carlsen represented Team Liquid, while American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura secured third place.

national_news.title: DRI Uncovers Major Areca Nut Import Scam Exploiting SAFTA Agreement
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) under the Ministry of Finance uncovered a major smuggling syndicate defrauding the exchequer of over Rs 2,500 crore.

Syndicates illegally imported areca nuts from South-East Asian countries (Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia) by mis-declaring their origin as Bangladesh to fraudulently claim duty exemptions under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement.
Areca nut imports normally attract a Basic Customs Duty (BCD) of 100%, whereas eligible imports under SAFTA from Bangladesh enjoy complete exemption.
Operations led to the arrest of nine persons, seizure of about Rs 75 lakh in cash and 160 metric tonnes of areca nuts, and suspension of the license of the involved Customs Broker firm.

national_news.title: DRI Uncovers Rs 2,500 Crore Customs Duty Fraud in Areca Nut Imports
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) dismantled a major smuggling network involving areca nut imports from Southeast Asia falsely declared as Bangladeshi origin.
The operation uncovered a potential revenue loss of over Rs 2,500 crore by fraudulently availing concessional duty benefits under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA).
Nine persons have been arrested, Rs 75 lakh in cash and 160 metric tonnes of areca nuts were seized, and the license of the primary Customs Broker firm was suspended.

national_news.title: Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition 2026 Opens at Rashtrapati Bhavan
bullets: Amrit Udyan at Rashtrapati Bhavan opened for public visits under the Summer Annuals Edition 2026, remaining open until September 15.
Entry to the gardens is free of cost, with pre-booked online slots required through the official Rashtrapati Bhavan portal.
Visitor entry and exit are designated through Gate No. 35 near North Avenue Road, with ancillary facilities like shuttle services from Central Secretariat Metro Station provided.

national_news.title: Customs Officials Seize Gold Worth Rs 2.65 Crore at Chennai Airport, Two Myanmar Nationals Arrested
bullets: Customs Air Intelligence Unit (AIU) at Anna International Airport in Chennai seized 1,967 grams of 24-karat gold valued at Rs 2.65 crore.
Two Myanmar nationals arriving from Bangkok were arrested after personal searches revealed cut gold bars concealed inside their bodies.
The accused were remanded to judicial custody under the provisions of the Customs Act, 1962.

national_news.title: India Inks Rs 1,943 Crore Deal to Lease Two MQ-9B Sea Guardian Drones for Indian Navy
bullets: The Ministry of Defence signed a contract worth approximately Rs 1,943 crore with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI).
The agreement entails leasing two MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance (HALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems for 30 months.
The acquisition significantly strengthens the Indian Navy's Maritime Domain Awareness, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance capabilities across the Indian Ocean Region.

national_news.title: Security Agencies Dismantle ISI-Backed Shahzad Bhatti Network in Multi-State Crackdown
bullets: Indian security agencies conducted a multi-state operation across 14 states, detaining 253 individuals and arresting over 200 operatives linked to the ISI-backed Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN).
The syndicate was planning subversive terror attacks ahead of Independence Day through grenade, IED, and petrol bomb attacks as well as targeted espionage.
Substantial recoveries including IEDs, Pakistan Ordnance Factory-marked grenades, and firearms were made, with cases booked under the UAPA and Arms Act.

national_news.title: DFS Hosts PSB Confluence 2026 Focusing on Banking Reforms and Youth
bullets: The Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, hosted the two-day PSB Confluence 2026 to strategize for public sector banks.
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced that a High-powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat will be formed soon.
Key themes discussed include Deposit Mobilisation, Banking for Youth (targeting 29% of India's population aged 15-29), Supporting the Investment Cycle, and Global Capability Centres (GCCs).

national_news.title: India Ranks as World's Largest Producer of Areca Nut in 2025-26
bullets: India is the world's largest producer of Areca Nut (betel nut/supari), accounting for about 63% of total global production in 2025-26.
According to the Directorate of Arecanut and Spices Development (DASD), total production reached 15.29 lakh tonnes across 11.06 lakh hectares.
Karnataka is the leading producer in India, contributing around 10 lakh tonnes, followed by Kerala, Assam, and other northeastern states.

national_news.title: Centre Approves ₹1,419 Crore for Qadian-Beas Railway Line in Punjab
bullets: The Centre approved a detailed estimate of ₹1,419.05 crore for the 39.68 km Qadian-Beas broad gauge railway line in Punjab's Majha region.
Revived under the Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme, the project features 11 major bridges, 54 Road Under Bridges (RUBs), and indigenous Kavach anti-collision technology.
The project connects Qadian in Gurdaspur district with Beas in Amritsar district, serving as an alternative strategic corridor for the Amritsar-Pathankot section.

national_news.title: India-EU FTA and CBAM Implementation Pose Compliance Challenges
bullets: India and the European Union concluded Free Trade Agreement (FTA) negotiations in January 2026.
Simultaneously, the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entered its definitive financial phase.
Experts warn that differing carbon measurement frameworks between India and the EU risk creating a double compliance burden for Indian exporters, potentially undercutting FTA gains.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans 100 Modern Bus Stands to Boost Transport and Infrastructure
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister announced plans to construct over 100 modern, state-of-the-art bus stands across the state.
The initiative aims to ramp up road transport connectivity, strengthen urban infrastructure, and accelerate industrial development.
The announcement was made during the unveiling of a statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Jamui district.

bihar_news.title: Railway Ministry Approves ₹2,627 Crore Sherghati-Kajree Rail Link Connecting Bihar and Jharkhand
bullets: The Railway Ministry issued a sanction memorandum for the 107.89-km broad gauge railway line connecting Sherghati (Gaya, Bihar) and Kajree (Palamu, Jharkhand).
The estimated cost of the project is ₹2,627.29 crore, with allocations made for Civil Engineering, Signal and Telecommunication, and Electrical departments.
The project is expected to reduce travel distance between Sherghati and Daltonganj by about 70 km and boost regional trade and employment.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Warns Government Doctors Against Unnecessary Patient Referrals
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister issued a stern warning to government doctors against unnecessary patient referrals from hospitals.
District hospitals are being equipped to perform 36 types of surgeries to ensure patients receive quality treatment closer to their homes.
Strict departmental action has been mandated for doctors who refer patients without medical justification.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Focuses on Speeding Up Aviation Infrastructure in Six Districts
bullets: The Bihar government is actively working to expedite the development of aviation and air facilities across six districts.
The initiative aims to improve regional connectivity and boost transportation infrastructure in the state.
It aligns with the broader state objective of upgrading public infrastructure and boosting economic growth.

bihar_news.title: Hoymiles Commissions 7.7 MW Solar Project in Gaya under PM-KUSUM
bullets: Global energy solutions company Hoymiles commissioned a 7.7 MW solar power project in Gaya, Bihar, under the PM-KUSUM initiative.
The project deployed 20 units of 350 kW HINV350HX-G2 string inverters, supplied through distribution partner Sun Solista and executed by Naw Dharam Energy.
The project marks Hoymiles' foray into utility-scale string inverter deployments in the region to support local grid stability.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Activities After October 15, Announces CM Samrat Choudhary
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced that the state will resume mining activities after October 15, following the auction and allocation of critical and strategic mineral blocks.
The tender process for 28 mining blocks is currently underway, with over 30 blocks expected to be allotted before the end of September.
The government has set targets of attracting Rs 5 lakh crore in investment and creating one crore jobs by 2030 to boost industrial expansion.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Mines Organises Roadshow for 8th Tranche of Critical Mineral Blocks in Patna
bullets: The Ministry of Mines organized a roadshow in Patna on August 17, 2026, for the 8th tranche of auction of critical and strategic mineral blocks.
The program was chaired by Union Minister of State for Coal and Mines Satish Chandra Dubey, alongside Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary and State Mines Minister Pramod Kumar.
The 8th tranche comprises 20 mineral blocks (3 Mining Lease and 17 Composite Licence blocks) covering minerals like Graphite, Rare Earth Elements (REE), Vanadium, Gallium, and Titanium.

bihar_news.title: Administrative Structure and District Profile of Bihar
bullets: Bihar comprises 38 districts administered under 9 administrative divisions: Patna, Tirhut, Saran, Darbhanga, Kosi, Purnia, Bhagalpur, Munger, and Magadh.
West Champaran is the largest district by area (5,229 sq km), while Sheohar is the smallest.
Patna is the most populous district, and the state shares its international boundary with Nepal to the north, covering 7 border districts.

bihar_news.title: Successful Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Bihar led to record turnout in assembly polls: CEC
bullets: Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar stated that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Bihar led to a significant increase in voter turnout.
The exercise involved removing around 70 lakh names from the electoral rolls over a three-month period.
The assembly polls registered a voter turnout of 67.25 per cent, the highest since Independence and higher than several major democracies.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Sets Rs 5 Lakh Crore Investment Target and Announces Industrial Reforms
bullets: Bihar aims to achieve an ambitious investment target of Rs 5 lakh crore by November.
The state government announced new industrial policies and welfare measures during Independence Day addresses.
The administration has set a target to provide employment opportunities to 1 crore youths by the year 2030.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Key Cultural, Tourism and Welfare Initiatives
bullets: The Bihar government announced the organization of the 'Sri Guru Sant Ravidas Kalash Yatra' at the block level from August 18 to August 20.
Special emphasis is being laid on developing natural sites into world-class eco-tourism centers to boost regional tourism.
The state government highlighted continuous welfare measures being undertaken for the upliftment of Mahadalit, Dalit, backward, and extremely backward classes.
